title: Add cross-scenario trade cap loss streak and cooldown isolation tests
description:
Write an integration test module tests/integration/test_entry_policy_restart.py and a verification document docs/verification/phase_l_entry_controls.md. The integration tests must exercise the real modules from l.1-l.4 (budgets/reservations, sizing, entry_eligibility, session_policy, market_filters) against a temporary SQLite WAL database (tmp_path) using the existing persistence layer and a deterministic fake clock; no broker, network, or credentials. Required scenarios: (a) cross-scenario isolation — two named SHADOW scenarios plus a PAPER key share no budgets, reservations, daily cycle counts, losing streaks, lockouts, or cooldowns; exhausting one does not affect the others; (b) restart durability — after consuming daily cycles, incrementing a losing streak, starting a cooldown, and holding reservations, construct fresh service instances over the same database and assert all state is preserved; then advance the fake clock to the next New York trading session and assert cycle counts and next_session lockouts reset while manual-mode lockouts persist until an audited reset; (c) partial-fill semantics end to end — first positive partial fill consumes one cycle and converts reservation, final cancel releases unused budget, zero-fill cancel consumes nothing; (d) simultaneous signals under shared budget lock — concurrent eligible signals for multiple symbols produce deterministic priority-ordered acceptance without overcommit; (e) entry blocks never block exits — with entries blocked by cycles, lockout, cooldown, daily loss, cutoff, and stale data, protective-stop/fill-ingestion/manual-close/risk-exit paths still proceed. The verification doc must list each phase-l control, the test(s) that cover it with file::test_name references, the exact targeted pytest commands used, observed results (pass/fail counts copied from the actual run), and any known gaps (e.g. provisional fee handling, capabilities not yet demonstrated in Alpaca paper). Do not modify production code; if a defect is found, document it in the verification doc as a failing/xfail-with-reason finding rather than editing other files.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/portfolio/budgets.py, mike_trade/portfolio/reservations.py (l.1)
- mike_trade/portfolio/sizing.py (l.2)
- mike_trade/risk/entry_eligibility.py (l.3)
- mike_trade/risk/session_policy.py and mike_trade/risk/market_filters.py (l.4)
- tests/unit/test_budget_reservations.py, tests/unit/test_position_sizing.py, tests/unit/test_entry_eligibility.py, tests/unit/test_session_policy.py for fixtures and conventions
- Existing persistence/migration setup, fake clock, and tests/conftest fixtures from earlier phases

Decision budget: only add the two allowed files; do not add fixtures elsewhere or change production modules.
acceptance_criteria: tests/integration/test_entry_policy_restart.py exists and uses a temporary SQLite database and a deterministic fake clock with no network, broker, or credential access
A test proves two SHADOW scenarios and a PAPER account have fully isolated budgets, reservations, daily cycle counts, losing streaks, lockouts, and cooldowns
A test proves cycle counts, losing streaks, cooldowns, and reservations survive constructing fresh service instances over the same database
A test proves cycle counts and next_session lockouts reset at the next New York trading session while manual lockouts persist until an audited reset
A test proves first positive partial fill consumes one cycle, final cancel releases unused reservation, and zero-fill cancel consumes no cycle
A test proves concurrent eligible signals are accepted in deterministic priority order without exceeding total_budget_usd
A test proves protective-stop, fill-ingestion, manual-close, and risk-exit paths proceed while new entries are blocked

docs/verification/phase_l_entry_controls.md maps every phase-l control to specific test references, records the exact targeted pytest commands run with their actual pass/fail counts, and lists known gaps
No production files are modified by this task
tests/integration/test_entry_policy_restart.py passes when run on its own with pytest, or any failure is documented with reason in the verification doc
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
access broker credentials, network, or create broker orders
run broad test suites or backtests
fabricate test results in the verification document
